text: As of recent data, JKN covers approximately 220 million beneficiaries, with around 60% being from poor to near-poor communities. Despite this extensive coverage, there remains a substantial out-of-pocket (OOP) expenditure for healthcare in Indonesia, accounting for over 30% of the current health expenditure (CHE). The program's expansion and financial support have been pivotal in reducing these individual costs, yet the significant OOP spending highlights ongoing challenges in achieving complete healthcare financial security for all Indonesians.
